title: Active Combat
notes: You fight now: press SPACE, tap the screen or hit STRIKE to attack yourself. Your own strikes charge crystals much faster than auto attacks.
Parry: when an enemy is about to hit you, a red ! appears above it. Press SPACE in that moment to block, counter, stun it and earn a full crystal. Mashing does not parry, timing does.
Skills come often now (about every 2-3 seconds when you fight actively). Keys: 1/2/3 or Q/W/E for skills, R for the Ultimate.
The crystal bar is labelled and shows a live hint about what to do next.
Stuns can no longer lock enemies forever (short immunity after each stun).
Rebalanced for active play: enemies hit harder and last longer, Arena fights take about 15 seconds. Playing actively is rewarded.
